description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" compares the performance of two models, LLLaMA-3-8B-it and another unnamed model, across various academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, which include GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. Each dataset and metric has two bars adjacent to each other, one for each model, with the LLLaMA-3-8B-it model represented in blue and the other model in orange. The bars are sorted in descending order of the LLLaMA-3-8B-it model's performance, starting with the highest score of 80 for GSM-8K and ending with the lowest score of 20 for Chat-Arena-Hard. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner, indicating the color coding for each model. The chart does not annotate specific data values above the bars, but the approximate values can be inferred from the scale and tick labels. The chart is designed to provide a visual comparison of the two models' performance across the different benchmarks without drawing any conclusions or making inferences about the data.
